docs.acting: Act on Sessions. Let Notchling reply to agents, answer their prompts and stop or start sessions.
docs.bridge: Phone Bridge. Let a paired phone follow and answer your agent sessions over the network.
docs.accounts: Logins and Lanes. Switch the Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity login in use and run lanes that each keep their own login.
docs.vault: Secret Vault. Keep passwords, API tokens and other credentials that agents can ask for.
docs.install: Install Hooks and Skills. Add Notchling's hook and skills to Claude Code's settings.
docs.awake: Keep awake. Keep the Mac from sleeping: off, always on, or only while agents work.
docs.display: Keep display on. Keep the screen on too, not only the system.
docs.resume: Continue agents after sleep. Resume background sessions after the Mac wakes up.
docs.shownotch: Show agents in the notch. Show running agent sessions in the camera notch at the top of the screen.
docs.width: Width. How wide the notch's panel opens: small, medium or large.
docs.pet: Animate pet. The little animated pet that lives in the notch.
docs.lastreply: Show the last reply when peeking. Show an agent's last reply when you hover over the notch.
docs.replynotch: Reply to background agents from the notch. A reply box in the notch for sessions running in the background.
docs.answernotch: Answer prompts from the notch. Answer an agent's questions and permission requests from the notch.
docs.pages: Keep local copies of artifacts. Save a copy of every artifact page you publish on this Mac.
docs.limit: Claude Code limit. What happens when the Claude Code account in use nears its usage limit: off, notify, or notify and switch to another account.
docs.codexlimit: Codex limit. What happens when the Codex account nears its usage limit: off, notify, or notify and switch.
docs.agylimit: Antigravity limit. What happens when the Antigravity account nears its usage limit: off, notify, or notify and switch.
docs.switchat: Switch at. The percent of the limit at which Notchling moves to another account.
docs.codexnet: Allow network in Codex turns. Let Codex reach the internet while it works on a task.
docs.history: Conversation history to load. How much of a conversation Chat loads: the newest 2, 4, 8 or 16 MB of its file.
docs.accountswin: Accounts. Add, remove and switch saved Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity accounts and see each one's limits.
docs.phone: Phone. Pair a phone with a QR code so it can follow your sessions.
docs.shortcut: Search Shortcut. Command Shift P opens Search from anywhere.
docs.appearance: Appearance. Follows the system's light or dark mode.
docs.hooks: Hooks. Which Claude Code events Notchling's hook handles, such as permission requests and notifications.
